user_session.settings.title: Geo-IP Settings
user_session.settings.subtitle: The provider that locates sign-in addresses for the login-risk checks, for the whole installation
user_session.settings.geoIpProvider.desc: Where a sign-in address is located, for impossible-travel and new-country checks and the session list. One provider for the whole installation. ipinfo works without a key. ip-api needs an API key (it has no keyless https endpoint); without one the lookup uses ipinfo. ipgeolocation needs an API key.
